_note: Arrow wounds on the vampire lord form: shafts in grey skin and wing membrane, thick dark blood. Overrides the arrow source over common.json. Schema: ../guide.md (Groups). No numbers in narration.

levels: , the point punching into the grey skin. Dark blood beads around the shaft and {name} hisses and recoils.
, the arrowhead tearing in where the skin is already torn. Dark blood spills down the shaft and {name} lets out a piercing shriek.
, and the arrow sinks deep into the open wound. Dark blood gushes, steaming, and {name} screeches, wings flaring.
, and it is too much. {name} crumples around the arrows, wings spread limp, dark blood pooling beneath.
